description: Adds more/fewer than X credits options to user criteria form
replace:
<!--[XF:user:content_after_trophies]-->

				<xf:option name="user_criteria[oc_credits_more][rule]" value="oc_credits_more" selected="{$criteria.oc_credits_more}"
					label="User has at least X credits:">
					<xf:numberbox name="user_criteria[oc_credits_more][data][credits]" value="{$criteria.oc_credits_more.credits}"
						size="8" min="0" step="0.01" />
				</xf:option>

				<xf:option name="user_criteria[oc_credits_fewer][rule]" value="oc_credits_fewer" selected="{$criteria.oc_credits_fewer}"
					label="User has fewer than X credits:">
					<xf:numberbox name="user_criteria[oc_credits_fewer][data][credits]" value="{$criteria.oc_credits_fewer.credits}"
						size="8" min="0" step="0.01" />
				</xf:option>
